subject: Renewal + Capacity Top-up — billing entity and PO details
messages:
From: Emily Starr <emily.starr@novacorp.com>

Cc: Lars Mikkelsen <lars.mikkelsen@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + capacity top-up — billing entity and PO details

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the renewal quote — we want to accept the 12-month renewal and add the +20% capacity top-up (S3 tier). A couple of items our finance team needs before we can route a consolidated PO: 
- Can Redwood invoice NovaCorp EU Ltd (single billing entity) for the renewal + top-up and ship a single consolidated invoice monthly?
- We need the exact remit-to EFT details and your vendor name / tax ID for EU invoicing (we have the VAT on file but need the vendor EIN equivalent).
- Our procurement prefers Net60 for enterprise renewals. Please confirm if Redwood can accommodate Net60 for this renewal (deal 8819) or if we need a different payment path.
- Please provide a template/line-item PO format we can submit; we typically attach a 1-page annex to our PO with the billing contact and billing address.

Attaching an internal PO request spreadsheet for reference. If there is an SOW amendment or an addendum we need to sign for the top-up, please return a DocuSign link.

Thanks — Emily

Attachments: NovaCorp_PO_Request_0429.xlsx (xls)

--
Emily Starr
Senior Procurement Manager | NovaCorp

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 14:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity top-up — billing entity and PO details

Hi Emily — great to hear, and congrats on the team growth. Short answers up front: we can invoice NovaCorp EU Ltd as a single monthly consolidated invoice and accept Net60 for this renewal provided we capture a few items up front. Details below and next steps.

What we need from NovaCorp to proceed:
1) Confirm the billing entity: "NovaCorp EU Ltd" (legal name) and provide the VAT/Tax ID you want shown on invoices.
2) Provide the formal PO (PDF) with a reference to deal id DEAL-8819; we will mirror the PO number on our invoices.
3) If payment terms move from Net30 to Net60, we require a signed amendment to the Master Services Agreement (one-page addendum) that we can send via DocuSign.
4) Remit-to: we will provide Redwood EU banking details (IBAN/BIC) once we have the billing entity — we also need the payor legal name for your AP (who will be remitting funds).

Operational notes: we can accept a single consolidated monthly invoice that includes the top-up as a separate line item. For EU VAT handling we will display VAT on the invoice and include your VAT ID. If you prefer to have the renewal charged to a different legal entity (e.g., US parent), tell us and we'll follow the PO.

Attached is a draft SOW amendment (Redwood_SOW_Amendment_Draft_v1.pdf). Once you confirm the billing entity/VAT and the desired PO number, I will send the amendment via DocuSign and loop our finance for the Net60 approval.

DocuSign preview link (will email a signing link after your confirmation): https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=eyJhbGci...

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad

mina_haddad@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: NovaCorp billing setup for Net60 (DEAL-8819)

Looping in finance ops notes for the record. If NovaCorp wants Net60 we need:
- Signed MSA amendment attached to the first invoice (DocuSign envelope id will be archived).
- Accounting requires the PO number on the invoice header (no free-text PO).
- We should create an invoice alias for "NovaCorp EU Ltd" and route copies to eu-ap@novacorp.com as the billing contact. Jordan, please create the alias and ensure the VAT ID field is exposed on the outgoing invoice PDF.
- Treasury: Redwood EU bank details (IBAN/BIC) to be used; treasury will create a payment instruction memo referenced on the invoice.

I will proactively approve Net60 for this customer for this renewal, conditional on the signed amendment and receipt of PO. Mina — please request the PO PDF attached to the confirmation so we can move to billing.

Thanks,
Vivek

--

Mina — thanks, all confirmed. We are issuing PO 8819-RENEW today; attached is the signed PO PDF and our VAT info: GB999999973 (NovaCorp EU Ltd). We will route the PDF to your AP inbox.

A few quick notes:
- PO number: 8819-RENEW (please mirror exactly on invoices).
- Billing contact: eu-ap@novacorp.com (please include this line on invoice and CC for the invoice delivery).
- We accept the DocuSign amendment; please send the envelope and we'll sign same day.
- Attached: NovaCorp_PO_8819.pdf (pdf) — includes the payment remitter details for our treasury.

We plan payment on Net60 terms; target payment date is 2029-07-13 assuming invoice date of 2029-05-14. If anything else is needed to expedite, ping me.

Thanks — Emily
